subject.title: fix(doctor): preserve allowlist entries for version-bound runtime plugins during stale config scan

question: Should `doctor --fix` permanently exempt every version-bound runtime plugin ID from stale allowlist cleanup, or preserve it only while configuration or package-cutover evidence shows the plugin is still intended?
rationale: The reported upgrade requires preserving intent, but an unconditional exception changes established stale-config cleanup after intentional uninstall; repository policy treats that compatibility tradeoff as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Scope to intended runtime state
options.body: Preserve the ID only during version-bound package cutover or when current provider/model configuration requires that runtime, retaining cleanup for truly stale allowlist-only entries.

options.title: Permanent version-bound exemption
options.body: Keep all version-bound runtime IDs immune to stale allowlist pruning and document that uninstall cleanup must remove those IDs through another owner path.

recommendation.title: Scope to intended runtime state
recommendation.body: Preserve the ID only during version-bound package cutover or when current provider/model configuration requires that runtime, retaining cleanup for truly stale allowlist-only entries.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history spans configured runtime collection, missing-plugin repair, Codex route repair, and auto-enable policy.
